source_type: public Markdown Editor application, isolated local execution
task: Improve this existing Markdown Editor for writing, editing, and reviewing documents at desktop 1440×900 and touch phone 390×844. Preserve its brand, real content, original functions and keyboard shortcuts: live rendered preview, file import, Markdown/HTML downloads, browser save/reload, shareable link, reading mode, night mode and spell-check toggle. Make the relationship between writing, preview and available actions clear and comfortable with long text and narrow screens. Do not invent product features, delete actions or add dependencies/assets/network services. Use existing CodeMirror and Markdown rendering. Keep original DOM IDs and global function/editor APIs compatible; only index.html, index.css, index.js are editable. Existing vendor files must remain unchanged.
common_harness_time: included in wall deadline; recorded separately
tools: forbidden to executors, checked in JSONL; no delegation
workflow_limit: frozen skill supplied as text, independent implementation/review unavailable within this matched three-reply format
hard_gates: Preserve all upstream task workflows and credits; no lost text, important unavailable controls, page overflow or fabricated verification. Baseline limitations documented.
visual_gate: Two fresh independent blind reviewers both explicitly prefer with-skill, paired mean difference >=2/24 in six frozen dimensions. Hard pass required for both. Ties, failures, unequal replies and timeouts remain reported; no retry/tuning this project.
delivery_format: exact old/new text patches, unique occurrence; no deletion of files; no model tools
baseline_gate_interpretation: Original limitations are reported by name. Hard failure means lost existing capability, new important inaccessible content/control, new overflow or fabricated verification; legacy limitations can still reduce quality scores.
load_rule: Frontend-polish route selects entry and task-path guide before viewing outcomes. Conditional diagnostics/layout/form references are not injected into this tool-free three-reply mode.
prior_project_policy: No TodoMVC tuning or rerating. No previous products or scores supplied. Frozen candidate not changed for this project.
